text:
maria: Heads-up — planning the weekend change window for the SLO-aware FF ramp. Thinking nightshift deploy (Sat 01:00-04:00 UTC). Can we agree on a safe rollout sequence and rollback rules?

aj: +1 for night window. Proposal: canary -> micro-ramp -> graceful backoff. Sequence: 1% (10m), 5% (15m), 20% (30m). Holdpoint checks at each stage.

olivia: For holdpoints let's gate on two SLOs: errors (5xx + model-confidence failures) < 0.5% and p95 latency < 300ms. If either breaches, pause and alert.

sam: Agreed. Also add a pin rule: if we pause at stage >1%, auto-pin traffic back to previous stable version for the affected cohort to avoid oscillation.

maria: Good. Deploybot, can you schedule the rollout and enforce those holdpoints? Also annotate release notes with the pin strategy and rollback playbook.

deploy-bot: Scheduling deploy window: 2026-03-28 01:00 UTC -> 2026-03-28 04:00 UTC. Rollout plan queued.

Code snippet for the rollout (for ops runbook):

```
deploybot schedule --service inference-api \
  --window "2026-03-28T01:00Z/2026-03-28T04:00Z" \
  --ff toggle.new_routing --ramp 1:10m,5:15m,20:30m \
  --hold "errors>0.5% OR p95>300ms" \
  --on-hold action=notify(oncall-ops) --on-breach action=pin(previous)
```

oncall-ops: I'll be on shift. I'll stub an alert dashboard and a quick smoke test script. If we hit holdpoint I will run the rollback playbook and post status.

aj: One extra safety net: enable model-variant fallback on hold (route to quantized-v1) — cheaper and faster to recover while we investigate.

olivia: Add a telemetry tag to the rollout so we can slice by cohort and region: `rollout_tag=slo-night-03-28`. Important for postmortem.

sam: Release notes draft (short): "Controlled night window rollout for new routing toggle. 3-stage ramp with SLO gates. Auto-pin on breach. Oncall and deploybot monitoring enabled."

maria: Perfect. Can someone double-check the hold thresholds in the monitoring dashboards? I don't want flaky p95 alarms to block a healthy ramp. Maybe require 2 consecutive buckets (5m) to trigger.

oncall-ops: Will do. I'll set the alert to 2 consecutive 5m buckets for both metrics and post screenshots before Friday EOD.

deploy-bot: Reminder: if any stage is paused for >20m, deploy will not auto-continue and requires a manual resume.

aj: A note for ops: if we see a small spike in p95 but errors are stable, prefer to hold and let caches warm rather than immediate rollback. Use the manual unblock checklist in the runbook.

maria: Thanks all. If no objections I'll mark the rollout as APPROVED and publish the release notes. :thumbsup:

olivia: Approved.

aj: Approved.

sam: Approved.

oncall-ops: Approved — I'll be oncall.

deploy-bot: Rollout approved and published. Reminder: change window pinned to nightshift, notifications on Slack channel.
